name: Yuigahama Morning
about: A proposed layout for the user's approval before the level is built (docs/LEARNINGS.md A8): the photographic KM2-2_yuigahama_morning.png, each piece at its own scale from how far its foot stands below the picture's horizon, spread along the beach in the order of its five lane pictures (KM2-2a to e), from the boardwalk's end (x = -12, where KM2-1 stops) to Grandma's shop. Game axes: x along the lane (m), z away from the camera (the play lane at z = 0), front: the z of a model's street face.
